definitionItems.revenue: Revenue: the amount paid for orders paid in the period that haven't been refunded (including shipping, after discounts). Refunding an order later reduces revenue.
definitionItems.merchandise: Net merchandise: item amounts minus the coupon discount allocated to each line, excluding shipping. Brands, categories, sale types and top products use this amount.
definitionItems.discount: Coupon discounts: merchandise discounts plus shipping saved by free-shipping coupons.
definitionItems.refunds: Refunds: orders marked as refunded in the period (by refund date), at the amount paid.
definitionItems.tiers: Member tiers use each member's current tier; members who upgraded during the period count toward their new tier.
definitionItems.exports: Exports: order details are filtered by order date and include every status. They contain personal data, so they require the view-orders permission and are recorded in the audit log. Product sales are filtered by payment date.

reports.tierDetail: {members, plural, one {# member} other {# members}} · {customers} ordered in this period
